# Inflow React

> @inriver/inflow-react is Inriver's React/MUI design-system library: a scoped theme, design tokens, and themed components for product UIs.

## Install and setup

Install `@inriver/inflow-react@react19-mui9.6` with React 19, React DOM 19, MUI 9.6, @emotion/react and @emotion/styled. Wrap your app in `<InflowProvider>` imported from `@inriver/inflow-react`. Set a distinct `cacheKey` for each independently deployed microfrontend. `mode` is `light` by default; the app controls light or dark mode. Bundled fonts and icons are optional: import `@inriver/inflow-react/local-assets.css` once in your global CSS entry.

The server-safe `@inriver/inflow-react/datetime` entry needs only the optional peer `dayjs` (`^1.11.0`) for preferences, formatters and grid column fragments. To render MUI X pickers, also install `@mui/x-date-pickers` (`>=9.0.0 <10.0.0`) and import `InflowLocalizationProvider` from `@inriver/inflow-react/datetime/client`. Keep `<InflowProvider>` at the app root. The root and `/datetime/client` carry `'use client'` boundaries. On the server, pass request-specific formatter options or provider props instead of calling `configureDateTime` per request; it changes module-wide state.

## Components and patterns

Themed wrappers (for example ThemedCard, ThemedChip, ThemedDialog, ThemedTable, ThemedTabs, ThemedAlert) are thin, composable MUI wrappers exported from the package root. Pattern shells compose them into page shapes: `ThemedTablePage` (list/table pages with toolbar, loading and empty states) and `ThemedDetailPageShell` (detail views with a controlled right panel). Copy-paste page recipes live under the Patterns section of the component catalog. In 4.0.0, `ThemedButton`/`ThemedButtonProps` and `ThemedTextField`/`ThemedTextFieldProps` were removed — use MUI `Button`/`TextField` inside `InflowProvider`. `inflowVariant` has no direct MUI equivalent: choose `variant="contained"`, `"outlined"`, or `"text"`. Removed `createDefaultTheme`/`defaultTheme` are replaced by `createInflowTheme`/`inflowTheme`, or MUI `createTheme` for an unthemed baseline. The removed `ThemedChatPanel` `onSend` prop is replaced by `onSendMessage(text)`.

Date and time preferences, display formatters and grid column fragments are exported from `@inriver/inflow-react/datetime`; `InflowLocalizationProvider` is exported from `@inriver/inflow-react/datetime/client`. The root entry does not load the optional peers. NodeNext / Node16 consumers resolve dual `.d.ts` / `.d.cts` declarations through exports.

## CLI

The package includes the `inflow` binary. Use `inflow --help`, `inflow component --list`, `inflow component ThemedChip`, `inflow tokens`, `inflow search chip`, or `inflow docs setup` (also `theming` and `migration`). Add `--json` for a machine-readable envelope. Unknown input exits 1.

## Token overrides

The provider emits 112 `--infl-*` variables on `[data-inflow-root]`, derived from the resolved theme. Override individual variables with the provider `sx` prop or CSS scoped to that root, not `:root`. Portaled content does not inherit these variables by default. See [Theming](https://inriver.github.io/inflow-react/#/theming) and [Design tokens](https://inriver.github.io/inflow-react/#/tokens).
